verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Qodo's own versioning, review, or rollback of automations or review configurations. The closest item is config-as-code via a .pr_agent.toml file. Any version history or rollback would come from the user's Git provider, a host-platform capability, not from a Qodo feature. Portal configuration (org and repo level overrides) likewise shows no version history or revert capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
